approximations: mitsuba: envmap rows resampled to v = j / (H - 1) because Mitsuba looks the map up at v * (H - 1) (corner-aligned rows; unfixed it reads the sun 0.15 degrees off and +0.4% bright on env-sphere).

mitsuba: material 'm0_Simple_Base': dielectric over diffuse is roughplastic with nonlinear true (closed-form internal scattering); pbrt coateddiffuse is the stochastic layered reference and differs by a few percent
mitsuba: material 'm1_Simple_Coated': clear coat on a dielectric: roughplastic (nonlinear) with the coat IOR/roughness; the base dielectric specular lobe is not added

mitsuba: material 'm2_Simple_Coating': dielectric over diffuse is roughplastic with nonlinear true (closed-form internal scattering); pbrt coateddiffuse is the stochastic layered reference and differs by a few percent
